title: Seagrove 103 S Gulf Dr. Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewPrivate HEATED pool in the heart of Seagrove! Public Beach - 2 Minute Bike Ride - 3 Bikes - `Mi Casa`The SpaceMi Casa is a newly updated spacious 3 bedroom 2 bathroom home that sleeps up to 7 guests along with its very own PRIVATE HEATED pool!Mi Casa, a charming vacation home, offers an ideal retreat for those seeking a blend of comfort and coastal adventure. Nestled in the picturesque Seagrove area, it is merely two blocks away from the breathtaking emerald waters and sugar-white beaches of the Gulf. This prime location allows guests to immerse themselves in the quintessential beach experience, complete with the serene sounds of the waves. The property boasts a stunning heated pool, available for an additional $50 per day, providing a perfect oasis for relaxation and leisure.Beyond its immediate comforts, Mi Casa's strategic location is a gateway to the broader charms of the region. It's conveniently situated just a bike ride away from the quaint Seaside, FL, and within a 5-mile radius of notable destinations like The Hub, Alys Beach, and Rosemary. The area is rich in amenities, including an array of dining and shopping options. For nature enthusiasts and active guests, the surrounding coastal dune lakes, pedestrian paths, state forest, and nature trails offer a plethora of activities like walking, running, and biking.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival****NO CABLE. STREAMING ONLY**Pool Heat*Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Pool heat max temperature is 87 degrees*Pool heat fee $50 per day and required for length of stay*Notification required one week prior to arrival to add pool heat*This home has a pool alarm required by Florida law which cannot be disabled.*Guests will be held responsible for any damage to the alarm.*Please note that we do not guarantee pool heat. *There is construction taking place behind the home.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:Master Bedroom: King sized bed (sleeps 2)Guest Room: King sized bed (sleeps 2)Guest Room: Twin over full bunk bed (sleeps 3)HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Private Pool/Heat option (Notification required one week prior to arrival to add pool heat)*3 Bikes Included*Wifi*Outdoor Gas Grill*Security cameras outside* Professionally Managed, 24/7 ServiceAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
